description: This file sets up a dependency injection container entry named 'ByIdFilterInterpreter' that returns a new instance of a filter interpreter class within the SuiteCRM JSON API filters namespace. It also imports relevant PSR and Slim interfaces and exceptions.

methods.name: $container['ByIdFilterInterpreter']
methods.description: Defines a factory function in the container that creates and returns an instance of ByIdFilter, passing the container itself as a dependency.
